main.p: On your Android phone, tap the button below to open the installed app. Apporo .7 or later is required.
Need to install or update? Download the current Android release.
Tap the button on this page. Pasting an app link into the address bar may open a search or show a website error.
Using LINE? Tap the menu and choose “Open in browser”, then tap the button again in Chrome.
This page opens the app only. It does not send a message, run a task or unlock your phone.
請按上方按鈕開啟 Apporo Assistant。手機需已安裝 Apporo .7 或更新版。
